items.title: Shelly Berg interviewed by Monk Rowe, Scottsdale, Arizona, April 15, 2000
items.q: Milt Jackson way up there too.

ctx.x: Well let’s talk about Cannonball Adderley.
Let’s forget all those other guys. Milt Jackson way up there too.
Well I’m just so pleased you said that because that’s how I feel too but I’m wondering why.
